 We are hiring for Walk in Drive for Any Banking Experience Domain for Bangalore.

 Interview Details: Interview Date:9th September 2026(Wednesday) Interview Time: 10.00 AM to 12:30 AM IST Only

 Please find below Job Description for your reference: 
 Job Location: Bangalore (Work from Office) Qualification: B.Com, BBA, BBM, B.Sc, BA, MBA, or equivalent(Full Time) / Not Considering (BCA & B.Tech Qualification) Total years for Experience: 2-4 Years Notice Period: Immediate to 15 Days Only Shift: Flexible to work for any shift and 5 days Office Job Level:3A Designation: Process Specialist 
 Note : Prefering only Bangalore candidate 
 Note: we are looking for Any banking experience 
 Job Summary: 
 We are seeking detail-oriented and highly motivated individuals to join our Payments Operations team. The role involves processing payment transactions, validating payment instructions, UMB Payee Expense Research & Adjustments Customer Information. Candidates should possess good typing skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work in a fast-paced operational environment. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Process payment transactions accurately within defined turnaround times. Review and validate payment instructions as per standard operating procedures. Perform data entry and transaction verification with a high degree of accuracy. Maintain process documentation and update trackers as required. Meet daily productivity, quality, and SLA targets. Escalate issues and risks promptly to the appropriate stakeholders. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth transaction processing. 
 Required Skills: 
 Good typing speed with high accuracy. Basic knowledge of banking and financial services is an advantage. Good written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in MS Excel and MS Office applications. Ability to work under deadlines and manage multiple tasks. 
 Documents to Carry: 
 Carry a printout your updated resume. Carry any 2 photo Identity proof( PAN Card / Driving License/ Voters ID Card/ Passport) All original education documents needs to be available for verification. (10th, 12th, Graduation (Sem Wise Marksheet, CMM. Provisional and Original Degree) 
 Mandatory to carry: 
 Smartphone with good front camera, charger and Headset for Assessment, Government ID proof Hardcopy. 
 Pointers to note: 
 Please do not carry laptops/cameras to the venue as these will not be allowed due to security restrictions. Original Government ID card is must for Security Clearance. 
 Thanks & Regards, Infosys BPM Recruitment Team

description:
Join a team which leverages media, legal and data-driven expertise to strengthen independent journalism, enable access to the law and promote responsible business.
 We are the corporate foundation of Thomson Reuters, one of the world s leading content and technology companies. A registered charity in the UK and the USA, our expertise is embedded across the globe.
 The Thomson Reuters Foundation s Product Technology team supports the digital tools, platforms and services that enable our staff to deliver work across multiple regions and programmes. We are seeking a Helpdesk Engineer to provide first-line technology support to colleagues across the Foundation, helping staff resolve day-to-day IT issues quickly, clearly and professionally.
 This is an entry-level technology support role suited to someone with strong troubleshooting instincts, good communication skills and a practical interest in helping non-technical users. The successful candidate will support common issues across laptops, accounts, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, collaboration tools, Wi-Fi, VPN, printers and business applications, while learning from more experienced colleagues across the Product Technology team.
 Key Responsibilities: Provide first-line technical support to TRF staff, responding to support requests through the team s ticketing system and other approved support channels. Triage, investigate and resolve common IT issues, including account access, password and MFA problems, laptop and peripheral issues, Wi-Fi, VPN, printers, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and collaboration tools. Escalate more complex incidents or service requests to appropriate colleagues or Thomson Reuters support teams, providing clear notes, relevant context and accurate troubleshooting steps already taken. Support onboarding and offboarding activities, helping ensure that new joiners and leavers have the right equipment, access and guidance at the right time. Maintain accurate records of support requests, resolutions, known issues and follow-up actions in the ticketing system. Create and update simple user-facing guidance, knowledge articles and internal support notes so that common issues can be resolved consistently. Communicate clearly and patiently with colleagues, translating technical issues into plain language and helping users understand next steps. Follow agreed information security, data protection and access management processes, escalating risks or unusual activity where appropriate. Contribute to continuous improvement of the helpdesk function by identifying recurring issues, process gaps and opportunities to improve staff experience. Work Mode: Hybrid (2-3 days work from office is mandatory every week). Shift Timing: 12pm IST to 9pm IST. Required Qualifications : Bachelors or Masters degree is required. At least 1-3 years of relevant experience. Basic computer troubleshooting skills and the ability to work through problems logically. Experience using and supporting Windows and/or macOS devices. Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and/or Google Workspace, including tools such as Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Gmail, Google Drive and Google Meet. Some familiarity with IT support, service desk or ticketing systems, and a willingness to follow structured incident and request management processes. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users. Good attention to detail, including the ability to keep accurate notes and follow agreed processes. A basic understanding of common workplace technology issues, including passwords, MFA, Wi-Fi, VPN, printing, software installation and account access. A customer-focused approach, with patience, professionalism and a willingness to help colleagues resolve issues. A willingness to learn, ask questions and develop technical skills through hands-on support work and guidance from more experienced colleagues. Relevant work experience, internship experience, customer support experience or demonstrable practical technical experience. Formal education in IT or computer science is welcome but not essential. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with Jira Service Management, ServiceNow or another ticketing platform. Basic experience with Active Directory, Azure Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID, or identity and access management concepts. Experience supporting enterprise collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint, Zoom, Google Workspace or similar platforms. Prior helpdesk, IT support, desktop support, internship or customer support experience in a medium-sized or large organisation. description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale - across every customer touchpoint. By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team - spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management - enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights. Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide. Job Description Sr. Success Manager (EMEA Shift) Sprinklr s Customer Organization focuses on four strong pillars of Client Experience, Operational Excellence, Profitable Growth and Team Culture. 
 Sprinklr s Customer Success Manager align highly skilled expertise , thought leadership and program management, and unlock the deepest level of partnership with customers. With a bias towards action and ability to deliver organizational-wide impact, the CSM strategizes and executes on a plan how the customer can do things differently and better using Sprinklr. 
 
 T he CSM develop s a deep understanding of the customer s business, processes, teams and technical architectures (tech stacks), to prescribe use of Sprinklr products and features to solve high level business challenges and resolve organizational inefficiencies. The CSM s advanced mastery of Sprinklr s product and solutions is paired with domain and industry expertise , business acumen, and exceptional communication and program management skills, positioning the CSM to take a consultative approach in informing and actioning on partnership strategy plans 
 Directly responsible for: Manage a portfolio of customers at scale, delivering proactive guidance, adoption support, and value realization across multiple accounts simultaneously through a structured engagement model. Prioritize customer needs effectively and drive outcomes through a mix of digital touchpoints, virtual engagements, and scalable success programs while maintaining high customer satisfaction. Demonstrate a strong understanding of SaaS platforms, customer workflows, integrations, and product capabilities to effectively guide customers on adoption and best practices. Translate customer business requirements into product recommendations, troubleshoot common platform queries, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive successful outcomes. Conduct Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to showcase value realization, align on business objectives , review adoption metrics, and identify opportunities to drive customer outcomes and growth. Cultivate relationships with key stakeholders across customer organizations and establish new relationships, directly or by introducing Sprinklr executives and product leadership. Build customer champions and advocates to ensure clients can articulate and understand the value Sprinklr is driving to their business. Oversee customer adoption journey, ensuring appropriate resources are engaged, and effective solutions are implemented, at each stage of the lifecycle to achieve successful outcomes. Ensure awareness of Sprinklr s product, product roadmap and new releases to all relevant customer stakeholders, in the context of the customer stakeholder s role, current and prescribed future use cases of Sprinklr. Co-develop a success plan with customer to deliver on agreed KPI s and success metrics. Conduct regular customer cadences to align on value realization, agreed business priorities, and provide thought leadership specific to client s evolving business needs. Leverage customer health data, product adoption insights, and consumption metrics to proactively identify risks, drive recommendations, and improve customer outcomes. Responsible for customer workspace configuration audits, partnering with cross-functional teams on the process and related deliverables. Drive customer enablement and self-service adoption through scalable playbooks, best practices, and digital programs to improve adoption, retention, and operational efficiency Proactively identify adoption blockers to eliminate consumption risk. Empower customers in using Sprinklr to minimize redundant workflows, processes and resources. Advocate for the customer with Sprinklr s Product Team and Partnerships Team which entails identifying product enhancements, opportunities and paths to solutions that require development and sometimes third-party partners. Increasing revenue from customers. Collaborate with the Sales, Solutions Consultant other cross-functional teams to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities. Develop a deep understanding of customer business objectives , industry trends, competitors and market dynamics to identify opportunities for value realization, expansion, and strategic growth. Preferred qualifications skills: Minimum of 6 -8 years experience in Customer Success, Technical Account management, Technology Consulting, or Technology Solutions Development. Experience delivering large-scale transformational programs across Fortune 100 enterprise clients customer experience functions, working across multiple lines of business to deliver organization-wide impact, often breaking through legacy silos. Ability to analyze customer s usage data, KPIs and health indicators to identify opportunities for improvement and translate into actionable recommendations, plan and path to solutions. Demonstrated experience and/or knowledge of marketing automation technologies, or contact center technologies digital transformation, AI solutions, market research and insights, business analytics, emerging technologies, and data management platforms and technology. Strong program management experience overseeing large, cross-functional teams to ensure timely execution of deliverables. Proven ability to explain complex technical concepts in business-friendly terms to customers, then explain customer needs to internal partners, as well as mapping business requirements into technical features. Interest in continuously learning and advancing understanding of tech industry, customer experience technologies, technology platforms and solutions, AI advancement, and trends with top global brands We focus on our mission : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data - helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things: Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM. Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience. Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability. We believe in our product : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything - and everyone - can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world s leading enterprise brands. We invest in our people : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off - it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus. To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here . To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here . EEO - Our philosophy : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we re more innovative, creative, and successful. Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter. Warning about Recruiting Scams: Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commissions advice to avoid these types of scams. If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

Customer Service Skills: o Download Install and Activate (DIA) Skills: Assist with download, install and activation of M365 and Windows products and services. o Assisting with Updating / Upgrading the Product or Service cross platform. o Assisting with purchasing a product or recommend one appropriately. 3. Technical Support Skills: o Assisting with delivering the appropriate post install technical support. o Troubleshooting with post install Software Issues (Windows, Office, Etc., Etc.) cross platform o Assisting with Device Network & Connectivity Issues (Internet, Browsing, Etc.) cross platform Addressing with "How To" Questions Qualifications: • Education: Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience). • Experience: o Prior experience in technical support or customer service. o Familiarity with Microsoft products and services. o Certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals, M365 Fundamentals) are a plus. • Skills: o Excellent communication skills (verbal and written). o Problem-solving abilities. o Patience and empathy. o Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.  Role Overview We are looking for a highly analytical Business Analyst with around 1 year of experience to support Profit & Loss (P&L) management, cost analysis, financial performance tracking, and business planning . The role will involve analyzing financial and operational data, understanding key P&L drivers, performing variance analysis, identifying cost optimization opportunities, and providing actionable insights to business and finance stakeholders. 

 Key Responsibilities Analyze monthly P&L performance across revenue, operating costs, manpower costs, overheads, and profitability. Perform detailed actual vs. budget vs. forecast variance analysis and identify key drivers of financial performance. Prepare monthly and periodic P&L reports, management reports, MIS, and financial dashboards . Analyze revenue, cost, contribution margin, operating expenses, and profitability trends. Identify major cost drivers and opportunities for cost optimization and productivity improvement . Support manpower cost analysis and workforce planning , including headcount, utilization, productivity, and employee-cost analysis. Conduct budgeting and forecasting analysis and support business planning activities. Develop financial models and scenario analyses to evaluate the impact of business decisions on profitability. Track and analyze key financial and operational KPIs and highlight deviations from targets. Partner with Finance, Operations, HR, and Business teams to understand financial performance and underlying business drivers. Convert complex financial and operational data into clear business insights and recommendations . Build and maintain Power BI/Tableau dashboards for P&L, cost, manpower, and operational performance. Automate recurring reports and improve the efficiency and accuracy of financial reporting. Support management with ad-hoc analysis, business cases, cost-benefit analysis, and profitability studies. 
 Key Areas of Ownership Profit & Loss (P&L) Analysis Cost & Expense Analysis Actual vs. Budget Analysis Actual vs. Forecast Analysis Variance Analysis Revenue & Profitability Analysis Manpower Cost & Workforce Analytics Cost Optimization Budgeting & Forecasting Financial Modeling KPI & Performance Reporting Data Visualization & Dashboards 
 Required Skills Around 2+ year of experience in Business Analysis, Financial Analysis, FP&A, Management Reporting, or Data Analytics. Strong understanding of P&L statements and financial performance metrics . Good understanding of revenue, operating expenses, gross/contribution margin, EBITDA/profitability, and cost drivers. Strong experience in Excel , including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, financial models, and data analysis. Experience with Power BI/Tableau for dashboarding and data visualization. Working knowledge of SQL for data extraction and analysis. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to identify financial trends, anomalies, and key business drivers. Strong communication skills with the ability to present financial insights to stakeholders. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Business, or a related field. NIT/IIT or other reputed engineering/business institution preferred. 
 Preferred Experience Exposure to FP&A, management reporting, or business finance . Experience in cost reduction or cost optimization initiatives . Exposure to manpower planning and workforce cost analysis. Experience with budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning. Knowledge of financial modeling and scenario analysis. Experience working with large datasets and building automated dashboards. Knowledge of Python/R is an added advantage.

Support senior leadership in evaluating legal exposure and developing appropriate risk-mitigation strategies. Contracts & Documentation Review, draft and negotiate commercial agreements, vendor agreements, service agreements, NDAs, purchase arrangements and other business contracts. title: Purchase Executive
description:
We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Purchase & Store professional with 3+ years of relevant experience in Strategic Sourcing, Procurement, Vendor Development, Supplier Management, Material & Capital Procurement, and Store/Inventory Management. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in sourcing new suppliers, vendor development, RFQ/RFP management, commercial negotiations, SAP operations, and procurement of materials, MRO items and capital purchases. Candidates from the Automobile, Tyre, Automotive Components or Manufacturing industry will be preferred. 
 Role & responsibilities Strategic Sourcing & Procurement Identify and develop reliable sources for materials, components, MRO items and services. Drive strategic sourcing initiatives to achieve cost optimization, quality improvement and timely availability. Conduct RFQ/RFP processes, evaluate quotations and prepare commercial comparisons. Negotiate price, payment terms, lead time, quality and delivery schedules with suppliers. Manage end-to-end procurement activities from sourcing to PO issuance and delivery follow-up.
 Vendor Development & Supplier Management Identify, evaluate and onboard new suppliers based on quality, cost, delivery and capability. Drive Vendor Development / Supplier Development initiatives for new and existing suppliers. Develop alternate and local sources to reduce dependency and improve supply continuity. Monitor supplier performance and coordinate for timely resolution of quality, delivery and commercial issues. Maintain strong and long-term vendor relationships.
 Material & Capital Procurement Handle procurement of raw materials, production-related materials, consumables, MRO items and indirect materials. Manage Capital Procurement / Capital Purchases including machinery, equipment, tools and related services. Coordinate with Engineering, Production, Maintenance, Finance and other functions for procurement requirements. Ensure timely procurement as per project and operational requirements.
 Import Procurement & Incoterms Handle import procurement activities, documentation and supplier coordination. Coordinate with suppliers, logistics and internal stakeholders for timely shipment and delivery. Good understanding of Incoterms, international sourcing and import processes. Ensure proper documentation and compliance with applicable procurement requirements.
 Store & Inventory Management Manage day-to-day Store and Inventory operations. Monitor stock levels, material movements, consumption and replenishment requirements. Ensure proper storage, identification, traceability and documentation of materials. Coordinate with Purchase, Planning, Production, Warehouse and other departments to avoid material shortages and excess inventory. 
 SAP & MIS Perform Purchase and Store-related transactions in SAP. Prepare and maintain MIS, procurement reports, supplier performance reports and inventory reports. Track open POs, pending deliveries, stock levels and procurement status. Ensure accuracy and timely updating of procurement and inventory data. 
 Preferred candidate profile Graduate in any discipline; B.E./B.Tech. Mechanical preferred. 3+ years of relevant experience in Purchase, Procurement, Sourcing & Store operations. Experience in Automobile / Tyre / Automotive Components / Manufacturing industry preferred. Strong hands-on experience in Strategic Sourcing and Vendor Development. Experience in Supplier Development and Vendor Management. Good knowledge of Material Procurement, Capital Procurement and MRO Procurement. Hands-on experience in RFQ / RFP, quotation evaluation and commercial negotiation. Good understanding of Incoterms and Import Procurement. Strong working knowledge of SAP. Proficiency in MS Excel and other MS Office applications. Strong analytical, negotiation, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

description:
Key Responsibilities 1. Paid Advertising Assist in planning, launching, and managing Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns. Monitor campaign performance including CPL, CTR, CPM, CPC, conversion rate, and ROAS. Identify underperforming campaigns, creatives, audiences, and landing pages. Coordinate with the creative and marketing team to test new ad angles, copies, and creatives. Maintain daily/weekly campaign performance reports. 2. Lead Generation & Funnels Manage and monitor lead-generation campaigns and marketing funnels. Track leads from ad landing page WhatsApp/call conversion. Identify drop-offs and suggest improvements. Coordinate with the sales team to ensure leads are properly tracked and followed up. Maintain accurate lead and campaign data. 3. Content & Social Media Assist in planning and publishing content across social media platforms. Research content ideas, trends, hooks, competitors, and industry developments. Coordinate with designers/video editors for creatives, reels, posts, ads, and promotional content. Help repurpose existing content into multiple formats. 4. Marketing Analytics Track and analyze campaign and funnel performance. Prepare daily/weekly/monthly marketing reports. Identify patterns and provide actionable insights. Maintain dashboards and spreadsheets for marketing KPIs. Use data to recommend where budget, effort, and resources should be increased or reduced. 5. Marketing Execution Execute marketing campaigns for book launches, author programs, publishing offers, events, webinars, and other initiatives. Coordinate with internal teams for campaign launches and deadlines. Assist in email, WhatsApp, remarketing, and other digital campaigns. Ensure campaigns and marketing assets are launched accurately and on time. 6. Research & Optimization Research competitors and successful campaigns in the publishing, personal branding, education, and creator economy space. Study successful advertisements, landing pages, offers, and messaging. Continuously test new marketing ideas and growth opportunities. Stay updated with changes in Meta Ads, Google Ads, AI tools, and digital marketing trends. KPIs for the Role Your performance will primarily be measured by: Qualified leads generated Cost per lead Lead-to-sale conversion rate Campaign ROI / ROAS Landing page conversion rate CTR and CPC Speed and accuracy of campaign execution Number of successful marketing experiments Quality and accuracy of reporting Who We Are Looking For You should be: Data-driven — comfortable looking at numbers and making decisions from them. Execution-oriented — able to take a task and get it completed without constant supervision. Curious — constantly looking for better ads, hooks, offers, and marketing strategies. Detail-oriented — small tracking or campaign errors should not slip through. Fast learner — digital marketing changes rapidly, and you should enjoy learning new tools. Good communicator — able to coordinate effectively with creative, sales, and marketing teams. Problem solver — when a campaign doesn’t work, you should think about why and what to test next. Preferred Skills Knowledge of any of the following is a plus: Meta Ads Manager Google Ads Google Analytics Google Sheets / Excel Canva WordPress / Landing Pages WhatsApp Marketing CRM tools Basic copywriting Marketing automation AI tools such as ChatGPT / Claude Experience & Education Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory. Freshers with strong digital marketing knowledge and practical experience are welcome. Internship, freelance, or personal experience running digital campaigns is a plus. Ideal Candidate We are not looking for someone who only knows how to post on Instagram. We are looking for someone who wants to understand: Traffic Leads Sales Revenue If you enjoy analyzing numbers, testing ideas, improving campaigns, and seeing your work directly impact business growth, this role is for you.

description:
Technical Sales Executive Adhesives | Coatings | Thermal Materials 30,000 Fixed + Commission | 50,000+ Earning Potential Company: Amatech Innovation Pvt. Ltd. 
 Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat | Travel across Gujarat & Maharashtra 
 Experience: 1–2 Years 
 Qualification: Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech / M.Sc. – Chemical, Polymer, Chemistry or related fields 
 Reports to: Founder Build Your Career in Technical Sales & Advanced Materials Want a career where your technical knowledge can directly translate into business and income? Amatech Innovation is looking for a driven, technically curious and coachable Technical Sales Executive to join our growing team. This is not a conventional sales job. You will work directly with the Founder, meet OEMs and industrial customers, understand their technical challenges, recommend material solutions, coordinate product trials and convert successful technical engagements into commercial business. If you are ambitious, comfortable with field work and want to develop expertise in specialty adhesives, thermal management materials and protective coatings, this is an opportunity to build a strong technical-sales career from the ground up. About Amatech Innovation Amatech Innovation Pvt. Ltd. is an Ahmedabad-based advanced materials technology company developing and manufacturing high-performance specialty materials for demanding industrial applications. Our key technology platforms include: Linkobond® – Specialty Adhesives Amasil® – Thermal Management Materials Amacoat® – Protective & Functional Coatings Custom-engineered material solutions Our products are used for applications across: EV & Batteries | Electronics | Electrical | Automotive | Pumps | LED | Industrial OEMs We are a lean, founder-driven company with strong technical and R&D capabilities, now expanding our technical sales and business development team. What You Will Do Your job is to understand the customer's problem, identify the right technical solution and turn the opportunity into business. Key Responsibilities Identify and develop new OEM and industrial customers across Gujarat and Maharashtra. Prospect customers in EV/battery, electronics, electrical, automotive components, pumps, LED and industrial segments. Meet engineers, R&D teams, plant personnel, purchase teams and business owners. Understand customer applications, specifications, performance requirements and material challenges. Recommend suitable Amatech products or coordinate with the technical team for customized solutions. Conduct technical product presentations and customer discussions. Coordinate samples, trials, testing and technical follow-ups. Convert successful trials into commercial orders and repeat business. Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline. Maintain systematic records of customer visits, samples, trials, quotations and opportunities. Work with existing channel partners and support expansion of the distribution network. Achieve agreed activity, customer acquisition and revenue targets. Provide market intelligence and customer feedback to the Founder and R&D team. Who Are We Looking For? We are looking for someone who is technically curious, commercially driven and willing to learn. Preferred Profile Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech / M.Sc. in Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science, Chemistry or related disciplines. 1–2 years of experience in technical sales, application engineering, application support or industrial sales. Experience with adhesives, coatings, sealants, potting compounds, thermal materials, industrial chemicals or electronics/electrical components will be an advantage. Freshers with strong technical fundamentals and genuine interest in technical sales are welcome. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Comfortable discussing technical subjects with engineers and customers. Willingness to travel extensively across Gujarat and Maharashtra. Good English and Hindi communication; Gujarati or Marathi will be an advantage. Own two-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred. Attitude Matters More Than Experience We are particularly looking for someone who is: Driven • Coachable • Curious • Persistent • Customer-focused • Energetic • Comfortable with field work • Willing to learn If you want a desk-based 9-to-5 job, this role may not be for you. If you want to meet customers, learn technology, solve industrial problems, develop business and grow rapidly, we want to hear from you. Compensation & Earning Potential 30,000/month Fixed + Attractive Commission Your earning potential is linked to your performance. 30,000/month fixed salary Attractive commission on collected sales Performance-based incentives Quarterly bonuses Travel reimbursement Mobile allowance 50,000+ monthly earning potential for strong performers Performance-linked increase in fixed compensation Opportunity to take ownership of important customers, territories and accounts Performance = Growth At Amatech, we don't want salespeople who simply complete their daily activities. We want people who create customers and generate business. A strong performer who consistently develops customers and delivers collected sales can target 50,000+ monthly earnings, with significantly higher earning potential as the business grows. Your career progression will be based primarily on what you achieve — not simply how long you have been with the company. Why Join Amatech? Learn Advanced Materials Technology Gain practical exposure to specialty adhesives, thermal management materials, potting compounds, coatings and application engineering. Work Directly With the Founder Learn customer engagement, technical selling, negotiation and business development directly from company leadership. Work With Real Industrial Customers Interact with OEMs, engineers, R&D teams, plant heads and purchase teams rather than relying only on conventional distribution sales. Build Something From the Ground Up You will not simply inherit a territory. You will help build Amatech's technical sales function and customer base. High Performance = High Earning Potential Your income can grow significantly through commission and performance incentives. Fast Career Growth In a growing company, capable performers can take on responsibility much faster than in a traditional large organization. Build an Indian Advanced Materials Company Be part of a team developing and commercializing high-performance, India-origin materials for global industrial applications. Location & Travel Base: Ahmedabad, Gujarat The role involves regular travel across Gujarat and Maharashtra for customer development, technical meetings, product trials and business development. How to Apply Send your updated CV to: careers@amatech.co.in or info@amatech.co.in Subject: Technical Sales Executive – Amatech Please mention your current location, qualification, experience and notice period in your application. If you are ambitious, technically curious and ready to build your career in technical sales — we want to hear from you.

We are looking for someone who can understand a brand, conceptualize a unique website experience, create visually impressive designs, and transform those designs into clean, responsive, and functional websites. This role is ideal for a candidate who combines creative thinking, UI/UX expertise, branding knowledge, and strong frontend development skills . Creativity is a key requirement for this position. We are looking for someone who can think beyond templates and create websites that are unique, modern, visually engaging, and memorable. Key Responsibilities Conceptualize and design unique websites and digital experiences from scratch. Understand the client's business, target audience, brand identity, and requirements before starting the design. Create creative, modern, and user-friendly UI/UX designs. Convert design concepts into pixel-perfect, responsive, and functional websites. Develop websites using clean and structured HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript . Design, develop, and customize WordPress websites , including themes, layouts, and content structures. Work on frontend development and integration for Angular and Node.js-based projects . Ensure websites are responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. Maintain strong visual consistency, branding, typography, layouts, and design standards. Optimize websites for performance, speed, responsiveness, and SEO-friendly implementation. Handle website enhancements, updates, maintenance, and bug fixes. Experience or interest in the following will be highly valued: Logo design and conceptualization Corporate branding Brand identity development Typography and colour systems Corporate stationery Digital branding Marketing creatives Social media creatives Website visual identity The candidate should be able to understand a company's personality and translate it into a strong, consistent, and visually appealing brand identity . Creativity Our Key Requirement We are looking for a candidate with exceptional creative thinking and visual imagination . You should be someone who: Thinks beyond standard templates and commonly used website designs. Can create unique and original website concepts. Can visualize and conceptualize a website before beginning development. Can convert creative ideas into practical UI designs and working code. Has a strong eye for aesthetics, layouts, typography, spacing, and visual hierarchy. Is comfortable experimenting with new design concepts and digital experiences. Can create memorable and visually impactful websites. Understands how design can communicate a brand's story and personality. Has excellent attention to detail. Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript . Proven experience in WordPress development and customization . Good working knowledge of UI/UX principles . Strong understanding of responsive web design. Good knowledge of Angular and Node.js . Ability to independently design and develop complete websites. Strong understanding of typography, layouts, colour theory, grids, and visual hierarchy. Good knowledge of website performance and SEO-friendly development. Good to Have Experience creating custom WordPress themes. Knowledge of API integration and basic backend concepts. Experience with website animations and micro-interactions. Understanding of SEO-friendly coding practices. Familiarity with hosting, domains, SSL, and website deployment. Experience working in a creative or digital agency environment. Knowledge of Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe XD, CorelDRAW, or similar design tools. Portfolio Requirement A portfolio is mandatory for this position. Role Overview: 
 We are looking for a dynamic and technically strong Business Head (Metal) to lead the Precious metal business. 
 Must be strong 
 The role involves full business ownership into operations, and sales , with accountability for profitability and growth. The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of chemical processing, Metal Sales along with proven experience in managing large-scale process plants. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Business Head Metals & Chemical Processing The role involves end-to-end business ownership , with accountability for plant operations, feed sourcing, sales, profitability, and business growth . The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of chemical processing, metal extraction and sales , along with proven experience in managing large-scale process plants and commercial operations. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Business & P&L Ownership Lead the overall business for metals including Copper, Zinc, Lithium, Cobalt, and Nickel , with end-to-end accountability for business performance and profitability. Formulate and execute business strategies aligned with organizational growth objectives. Drive profitability through cost optimization, process efficiency, capacity utilization, yield improvement, and product realization . Own annual operating budgets, financial performance, working capital, and overall commercial outcomes. Identify opportunities for capacity expansion, new products, process improvements, and value-added downstream businesses. 
 2. Plant Operations & Manufacturing Provide overall leadership to plant operations , ensuring safe, reliable, efficient, and cost-effective functioning of the manufacturing facility. Drive plant performance across production, yield, recovery, quality, throughput, energy consumption, and operating costs . Ensure optimal utilization of installed capacity and continuously improve operational efficiency. Work closely with plant, process, maintenance, quality, EHS, and technical teams to achieve production and business targets. Establish and monitor operational KPIs and drive a culture of continuous improvement, productivity, and operational excellence . Ensure compliance with all applicable EHS, statutory, environmental, quality, and operational standards . 
 3. Feed Sourcing & Raw Material Strategy Own the end-to-end sourcing strategy for feed/raw materials required for the plant, ensuring adequate availability, quality, and competitive landed cost. Develop and maintain a strong network of feed suppliers, recyclers, aggregators, traders, and strategic sourcing partners . Identify new feed sources and geographies to ensure security and diversification of raw material supply. Lead commercial negotiations, supplier development, contract structuring, and long-term sourcing arrangements. Optimize the feed mix based on plant capabilities, metal recovery, processing economics, quality parameters, and market conditions. Work closely with technical and plant teams to evaluate the metallurgical/chemical suitability and economics of different feed materials . Ensure uninterrupted feed availability while optimizing inventory, working capital, logistics, and overall sourcing costs. 
 4. Sales & Business Development Develop and execute the sales strategy for extracted metals and value-added chemical intermediates . Build and manage relationships with key customers, strategic accounts, traders, and downstream consumers. Formulate commercial strategies covering pricing, customer engagement, contract negotiation, product positioning, and market development . Identify new markets and business opportunities to maximize product realization and margins. Develop long-term customer relationships and strategic partnerships to strengthen market positioning. Monitor metal and chemical market trends, competitor activity, pricing, and demand-supply dynamics to inform business decisions. 
 5. Integrated Commercial & Operational Management Balance feed economics, plant performance, metal recovery, product realization, and market pricing to maximize overall business profitability. Develop an integrated view of the business from feed sourcing plant processing metal recovery product sales cash realization . Ensure close coordination between sourcing, operations, sales, finance, and supply chain teams. Take data-driven decisions on feed procurement, production planning, inventory, product mix, and sales allocation. 
 6. Leadership & Team Management Build, lead, and develop high-performing teams across operations, sourcing, sales, commercial, and support functions . Establish clear performance metrics and accountability across the organization. Work closely with senior management/promoters on strategic decisions, investments, expansion plans, and overall business growth. Drive a strong culture of ownership, operational discipline, commercial excellence, and profitability .

Most of our market is outside India, so the work runs across time zones and is largely written. We do not run a volume-dial operation. description:
Supply Chain Product Manager - Orchestration Automation Job Description You were made to create Better Care for a Better World. As a person, you re a problem-solver - a connector - someone who thrives on creating order from complexity and driving continuous improvement. You see the big picture while mastering the details, ensuring that every product, process, and partnership flows with precision and purpose. You live your life in alignment with the highest values of integrity, efficiency, and collaboration, always working to turn today s challenges into tomorrow s success stories. In this role, you ll help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU. About You In one of our Supply Chain roles, you ll focus on winning with consumers and the market, while putting safety, mutual respect, and human dignity at the center. Job responsibilities include: Responsibilities Owning the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the overall Supply Chain Digital Orchestration and Automation digital capabilities and technical domains. Defines what success looks like, drives toward it, and tracks it using Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Providing cross-functional leadership, most notably between engineering teams, logistics, and support. A key aspect of this is communicating the product roadmap and keeping the product team and the stakeholders informed of updates. Collaborating with the Product Owner to leverage stakeholder insights to develop a living and breathing roadmap for the future while advocating for and driving alignment between stakeholders in the development of requirements, acceptance criteria, and solutions. Understanding how NA Supply Chain objectives intersect with the needs, pain points, and priorities of the user base of their Supply Chain Orchestration and Automation domains. Understanding what success looks like for different groups in terms of use cases and user experience, as documented with User Personas, Use Cases, and Case Studies. Accountability for stakeholder management at each point of the product lifecycle including requests, adoption, requirements gathering, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Representing the needs of Enterprise Supply Chain and Global Product Teams who own tools with overlapping use cases. Driving adoption of enhancements through user feedback sessions, training support, and an adoption roadmap. Developing and manages defined communication channel(s) and/or stakeholder groups, proactively seeking to identify potential demand, and drives the creation of the business case. Anticipating changes in customer/user needs, adapts product (with enhancements), and create product retirement and transitioning plans. Required Qualifications 3+ years of Product Management experience, or 5+ years of experience in a related field Experience integrating enterprise systems (SAP, Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, MES, etc.). Experience with Automation systems integration (Dematic, E80 and/or Wapiti). Experience with product life cycle management, especially with product vision, strategy, roadmap, and prioritization. Experience managing stakeholders, including senior executives. Strong cross-functional leadership, influence, collaboration, relationship-building, and communication skills. Desire and ability to crystallize and diagnose problems through cross-functional collaboration and troubleshooting. Detail-oriented, process-driven, and highly organized. Preferred Qualifications Prior experience working for a global, highly matrixed, Consumer Packaged Goods company. Experience with API architecture, middleware, or integration platforms. Experience working with teams organized around Agile ways of working. Experience conducting stakeholder interviews, market analysis, and other forms of research. Experiencing identifying goals, metrics, and analytics to measure value at a large scale (e.g., a product, a program). Familiarity with uncovering and championing high value use cases for data Familiarity with database structure (systems and data). Experience solving business problems with technology solutions. description:
Job Description: Finance Executive AP & AR Role Overview We are looking for a Finance Executive to manage day-to-day Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) activities, ensure timely accounting and collections, and maintain accurate financial records. The role requires strong attention to detail, good coordination with customers and vendors, and the ability to manage multiple transactions and deadlines. Key Responsibilities Accounts Payable (AP) Process and verify vendor invoices, purchase orders, and supporting documents. Ensure invoices are accurately recorded and approved before payment processing. Maintain vendor accounts and reconcile vendor statements. Track outstanding payables and prepare payment schedules. Coordinate with internal teams and vendors to resolve invoice discrepancies. Ensure timely processing of vendor payments. Maintain proper documentation for all AP transactions. Accounts Receivable (AR) Raise and issue customer invoices based on agreed contracts, milestones, and billing schedules. Track customer outstanding balances and maintain accurate AR records. Follow up with customers for overdue payments and payment confirmations. Prepare and share customer statements and ageing reports. Reconcile customer accounts and resolve billing/payment discrepancies. Coordinate with sales, project, and customer support teams on billing-related matters. Maintain regular collection follow-ups and provide updates on overdue accounts. Reconciliation & Reporting Perform regular bank, customer, and vendor reconciliations. Prepare AP/AR ageing reports and outstanding reports. Monitor overdue receivables and escalate long-pending balances. Support month-end and year-end closing activities. Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation. Assist in audit requirements and provide necessary financial data. Additional Responsibilities Ensure compliance with internal finance processes and controls. Maintain confidentiality of financial and customer information. Support management with finance-related reports and analysis. Identify process gaps and suggest improvements to improve billing, collections, and payment processes. Maintain clear communication with internal stakeholders, customers, and vendors. Required Skills Strong knowledge of Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable processes. Good understanding of basic accounting principles. Experience with invoice processing, billing, collections, reconciliations, and ageing. Good knowledge of MS Excel, including basic formulas and reporting. Experience working with accounting/ERP software. Strong follow-up and coordination skills. Good communication and interpersonal skills. High attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple priorities. Experience 2–5 years of experience in Finance, Accounts, AP/AR, or a similar role. Key Performance Indicators Timely and accurate invoice processing. Reduction in overdue receivables. Timely customer collections and payment follow-ups. Accurate vendor and customer reconciliations. Timely AP payment processing. Accuracy of financial records and reports. Compliance with internal finance processes.

In this role you will be primarily responsible for End-to-End Fixed Assets Accounting & Reporting and Internal Audit and Process Improvements and automation Process as SME or team focused on the complete, accurate, and timely completion of Fixed Assets & Reporting and related activities within the General Accounting (GA) team. Ensure compliance with internal guidelines and procedures as well as external regulatory requirements with strong understanding of USGAP and FA Module. Fixed Asset Accounting Operations Manage end-to-end fixed asset accounting processes. Ensure accurate capitalization, transfers, retirements, disposals, and depreciation of assets. Review and approve asset creation requests in compliance with accounting policies. Maintain the fixed asset register and ensure completeness and accuracy. Monitor Construction-in-Progress (CIP) accounting and capitalization activities. Financial Reporting & Month-End Close Execute month-end, quarter-end, and year-end fixed asset close activities. Review depreciation runs and accounting entries. Prepare and validate fixed asset reconciliations between subledger and general ledger. Support financial statement disclosures related to Property, Plant & Equipment (PP&E). Analyze asset balances and investigate significant movements. Compliance & Internal Controls Ensure compliance with IFRS, US GAAP, local statutory requirements, and company accounting policies. Maintain SOX/internal control documentation and evidence. Identify control gaps and implement corrective actions. Support internal and external audits through timely preparation of schedules and explanations. Asset Lifecycle Management Govern the complete asset lifecycle from acquisition to disposal. Ensure appropriate asset classification and useful life assignment. Review impairment assessments and asset write-offs. Monitor leased assets and right-of-use assets where applicable. Reconciliation & Data Quality Perform periodic asset register reviews and reconciliations. Resolve discrepancies between procurement, project accounting, and fixed assets records. Ensure asset master data accuracy and integrity. Develop and track key performance metrics related to fixed asset processes. Reporting & Analytics Prepare management reports on capital expenditures, depreciation, asset additions, and disposals. Support budgeting and forecasting activities related to fixed assets. Provide insights into capital investment trends and asset utilization. Develop dashboards and report solutions for stakeholders. Stakeholder Management Act as the primary point of contact for fixed asset-related queries. Partner with Finance, Procurement, Tax, Controllership, and Business Operations teams. Coordinate with external auditors, statutory auditors, and tax advisors. Provide guidance on fixed asset accounting treatments and policy interpretations. Process Improvement & Automation Identify and drive process improvement initiatives. Lead standardization and harmonization of fixed asset processes across entities. Support system implementations, upgrades, and testing activities (e.g., SAP, Oracle, S4-HANA,Trintech) Promote automation opportunities to improve efficiency and control. SME Governance Responsibilities Serve as the functional expert for fixed asset accounting. Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). Deliver training and knowledge-sharing sessions to team members. Provide guidance during transitions, migrations, and transformation projects. Review complex accounting transactions and determine appropriate treatment. title: Sr Account Manager - eProducts
description:
Job Summary Senior Account Manager - eProduct Renewals Are you a strategic renewals professional who excels at navigating complex negotiations and building trusted executive relationships Do you enjoy turning customer value into long-term partnerships while influencing commercial strategy and mentoring others This role owns the most commercially complex and highest-value accounts in the region. Where an Account Manager runs a defined renewal book, a Senior Account Manager carries the accounts where the outcome is not predictable: multi-site consortia, public tenders, competitive displacement attempts, contract restructurings, and accounts where the economic buyer has changed and the relationship has to be rebuilt from scratch. You will negotiate independently up to defined commercial thresholds, own the escalation strategy on at-risk revenue rather than handing it upward, and shape how the wider team approaches renewals through playbook contribution and deal coaching. You are the commercial lead; the Customer Success Manager owns adoption and value realization, and you convert that evidence into price and term. This is a senior individual contributor role with peer-leadership expectations. It does not carry direct reports. Position Details Territory: West India Reports to: Head of eSales, South Asia Southeast Asia Travel: Up to 50%, including intra-region and occasional global travel Responsibilities Own strategic renewals. Manage the region s largest, most complex and contested accounts, including public-sector, consortium, tender-led and channel-mediated renewals. Lead commercial negotiation. Negotiate price uplift, contract restructuring, product substitutions, tier migrations and multi-year terms within agreed thresholds. Maintain forecast discipline. Use MEDDPICC and Salesforce to qualify renewals, call risk early, and maintain accurate pipeline, value, stage and close-date data. Build senior stakeholder access. Engage economic buyers and senior institutional stakeholders, rebuilding relationships quickly when leadership changes. Convert value into renewal outcomes. Partner with CSMs to translate usage, adoption and business-review insights into commercial cases that support retention, uplift and expansion. Mitigate risk and grow whitespace. Identify at-risk revenue two quarters ahead of expiry, run documented save plans, and prioritize expansion where budget and product fit are strongest. Shape competitive positioning. Maintain regional market knowledge and prepare account-specific counter-positions against competing platforms and local alternatives. Represent customer voice. Escalate recurring feedback on content, relevance, user experience and integration to Product and Commercial Strategy with actionable detail. Requirements Proven experience in B2B commercial roles with significant experience in enterprise SaaS, digital content, subscription renewals, retention, or account management. Proven ownership of a scaled renewal book with measurable retention, price realization and expansion outcomes. Experience negotiating with institutional buying committees, procurement teams, public-sector authorities or channel partners. Strong command of structured sales methodology, preferably MEDDPICC, and disciplined Salesforce usage. Ability to build commercial cases using usage data, benchmark pricing, ROI evidence and customer value stories. Executive-level written and spoken English for senior correspondence and formal bid documentation. Experience in healthcare, health sciences education, medical publishing or clinical technology. Experience with distributors, public tenders, consortium purchasing or grant-funded institutional buying in South Asia or Southeast Asia.

description:

QUALIFICATIONS (Education/Training, Experience and Certifications) • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in taxation, economics, finance, law, or a related field. • Minimum 2 -3 years of professional experience in a tax accounting environment. • Experience in a multinational group environment is preferred. KNOWLEDGE SKILLS AND ABILITIES (Those necessary to perform the job competently) • Strong technical knowledge of tax laws, compliance, and advisory practices. • Analytical mindset with a structured and detail -oriented approach. • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English. • Fluency in English • Collaborative and solution -driven working style with a proactive mindset. • Open and adaptable attitude , embracing diverse challenges in a supportive and dynamic environment

 The Cost Accountant is responsible for analyzing, controlling, and reporting product and operational costs across the business. Variance Analysis & Reporting: Prepare detailed financial and operational reports highlighting cost drivers and profitability trends. Budgeting & Forecasting: Support annual budgeting and forecasting activities. Budgeting & Forecasting: Develop cost models and financial projections for new and existing products. Budgeting & Forecasting: Assist management in evaluating pricing strategies and margin improvements. Budgeting & Forecasting: Monitor actual performance against budget and forecast targets. Financial Accounting & Month-End Close: Prepare and post journal entries related to manufacturing and operational costs. Financial Accounting & Month-End Close: Ensure accuracy and completeness of financial records in accordance with accounting standards. Product Costing & Profitability Analysis: Develop and maintain product cost structures. Product Costing & Profitability Analysis: Analyze profitability by product, customer, channel, and business unit. Product Costing & Profitability Analysis: Evaluate the financial impact of changes in raw material prices, labor costs, and operational processes.

description:
Financial Services Executive - Operations & Client Servicing Job Type: Full-time
 Experience: 1-4 years preferred
 Location: Lajpat Nagar, New Delhi
 Industry: Financial Services / Mutual Funds / Insurance 
 About the Role We are looking for a smart, organised and proactive Financial Services Executive to join our growing financial services business. The role will involve a combination of mutual fund and insurance operations, client servicing, financial transactions, documentation, communication and general business support . The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of financial products, excellent communication skills and be comfortable using technology and AI tools to work efficiently. This is a hands-on, non-routine role where the candidate will be expected to take ownership of tasks, coordinate with clients and service providers, and manage multiple responsibilities independently. 
 Key Responsibilities Mutual Fund & Investment Operations Initiate and process mutual fund transactions through NSE and other relevant platforms Handle purchase, redemption, switch, SIP and other investment transactions Assist with KYC, account opening, FATCA, documentation and related processes Coordinate with AMCs, RTAs, NSE and other platforms for transaction and service-related requirements Track pending transactions and ensure timely completion Maintain accurate client and transaction records Insurance Operations Assist with new insurance business, policy servicing and renewals Coordinate documentation and service requests with insurance companies Track policy renewals, pending requirements and client requests Maintain organised records of policies and related documentation Client Servicing Communicate with clients through phone, WhatsApp and email regarding transactions, documentation and service requirements Respond to routine client queries professionally and efficiently Coordinate client meetings and follow-ups Occasionally accompany or visit clients for documentation, servicing or other requirements Build and maintain strong professional relationships with clients Technology & Business Support Maintain Excel/Google Sheets, digital records and databases Use online financial platforms, CRM tools and other business applications Effectively use AI tools such as ChatGPT for research, drafting, analysis, communication and improving day-to-day productivity Conduct online research and gather financial/product-related information when required Assist with occasional flight, hotel and other travel bookings Handle other operational and administrative responsibilities as required Entrepreneurial Mindset & Growth We are specifically looking for someone with an entrepreneurial spirit and an ownership mindset. You should be someone who: Treats the business and its clients with the same care and responsibility as you would your own business Looks for ways to improve processes, solve problems and make the business more efficient Is willing to take initiative rather than waiting for instructions for every task Is interested in learning and gradually taking on greater responsibility 
 Performance will be recognised and rewarded. Salary growth, bonuses and increased responsibilities will be linked to performance, initiative, contribution and the growth of the business. 
 What We Are Looking For The ideal candidate should be: Highly organised and detail-oriented Comfortable working with numbers, financial information and documentation Knowledgeable about mutual funds, investments, insurance and personal finance Excellent in spoken and written Hindi and English Confident and professional while communicating with clients Comfortable with computers, Excel/Google Sheets and online platforms Tech-savvy and interested in using AI tools to improve productivity A quick learner who can adapt to new software and processes Proactive and capable of taking ownership without constant supervision Good at following up and ensuring tasks are completed on time Presentable and comfortable with occasional client visits Reliable, responsible and discreet when handling client information Ambitious, self-motivated and entrepreneurial Preferred Qualifications & Experience Graduate in B.Com, BBA, Finance, Economics or a related field 1-4 years of experience in mutual funds, insurance, banking, wealth management, financial services or a similar role preferred Familiarity with NSE mutual fund transactions, AMC/RTA portals, KYC processes and insurance platforms will be an advantage Candidates with strong financial knowledge and excellent communication skills may also be considered even without direct industry experience Important This is primarily an operations and client servicing role, not a pure sales role. The position is ideal for someone who enjoys working across finance, technology, people and business operations and wants to develop a broad understanding of the financial services industry. We are looking for someone who wants to build something, take ownership and grow alongside the business.

description:
We are hiring for Manager Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) with Solar EPC Firm!! 

 Location : Karnal,Haryana 

 Role Summary: 
 We are looking for a Manager Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) to lead budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and business performance analysis. The role will act as a strategic finance partner to Plant, Sales, and Supply Chain leadership , providing actionable insights to support decisions around pricing, product mix, CAPEX, working capital, and overall business growth. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Lead the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and rolling quarterly forecasts across business segments, including solar pumps, agricultural & industrial pumps, motors, and exports . Prepare and present monthly MIS and business review reports for the CFO, MD, and Board, covering revenue, gross margin, EBITDA, cash flow, and budget vs. actual and prior-year variance analysis. Conduct product-wise, segment-wise, and customer-wise profitability analysis to support pricing, discounting, and commercial decisions. Analyse raw material cost movements including copper, steel, and polymers, along with plant conversion costs, overhead absorption, productivity, and operational efficiency. Evaluate CAPEX proposals by developing business cases and financial models covering IRR, NPV, payback period, and return on investment ; monitor post-implementation performance. Drive working capital analysis and cash-flow forecasting , including monitoring receivables, inventory days, vendor payment terms, and government/PM-KUSUM scheme receivables. Develop scenario and sensitivity models to assess the impact of commodity prices, government scheme/tender volumes, export demand, and other key business variables. Support Investor Relations (IR) activities by preparing financial data, quarterly earnings information, analyst responses, and investor presentations. Work closely with the IT/ERP team to enhance financial reporting capabilities and develop dashboards using Power BI and advanced Excel . Provide financial insights and analysis for strategic initiatives, M&A evaluations, long-range business planning, and other ad-hoc management requirements . Partner closely with plant and business teams to identify cost optimization opportunities and improve overall financial performance.

 Chartered Accountant (CA) with 36 years of post-qualification experience . Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in FP&A / Business Finance , preferably within a manufacturing environment . Strong expertise in financial modelling, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and advanced Excel . Exposure to Power BI or similar business intelligence/reporting tools will be preferred. Hands-on experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics , particularly for financial reporting and analysis. Strong commercial acumen with the ability to challenge business assumptions and translate financial data into actionable business insights. title: Associate Director- Operation
description:
About Loadshare LoadShare is one of India’s most innovative and resilient logistics platforms, transforming how goods move across the country. Founded in 2017, we’ve grown to become a pan-India, multi-category last-mile network with a unique presence in both Tier 1 metros and deep Tier 2/3 towns.  What sets us apart:  Scale with depth: We handle ~550K deliveries/day across food, e-commerce (B2C), B2B retail, and digital commerce, powered by a 30,000+ rider network.  Strong financials, stronger ambition: With 800+ Cr in FY26 revenue and support from global investors (Tiger Global, Matrix, BII, Stellaris, BeeNext), we have a long runway and a path to profitability.  Dual-engine model: We not only operate India’s most flexible last-mile delivery network, but also license our in-house logistics tech platform that processes an additional 20 lakh orders/day — one of the few in India to enable asset cross-utilization across verticals.  Strong Tech: We are in a unique position to cross-utilize the delivery boys across different earning opportunities matching the peaks of various use-cases throughout the day. (ex: grocery peaks at 6-8 am, while bike taxi peaks from 8 to 10 am, etc). In addition to this, our supply chain SaaS platforms power over 1M+ shipments per day. Strategic partner to India’s digital economy: We work with every major digital commerce player (ecomm, quick commerce, food, mobility) , and are expanding wallet share and capabilities within existing giants while co-creating new models with emerging platforms and brands.  Built to scale profitably: We’re not chasing GMV at all costs. We’re building the most capital-efficient, tech-enabled logistics engine in the country. We’re now building for our next phase: a 5X scale-up over the next 5 years, anchored in sharper client focus, deeper solutions, and new growth engines.  Founders/ Founding team:  Raghu Talluri (CEO) - Formerly at Myntra, McKinsey  Pramod Nair (CTO) - Formerly at Freecharge, Snapdeal, MartMobi  Rakib Ahmed (Co Founder, Head EComm/ Trucking/Warehousing)- Formerly at ICICI Prudential, Co founder Lunate Eco  
 Roles and Responsibilities 
 Job Responsibilities:  Hyperlocal/Quick-Commerce Network Expansion:  Launch and scale the operations across cities from scratch including hub setup, staffing, and training.  Plan and execute city-level ramp-ups, pilot projects, and cost modeling exercises.  Operational Excellence:  Ensure adherence to SLAs and quality metrics (GM/CM%, RTO, etc.).  Drive performance audits and implement SOPs to optimize cost-per-order and improve customer experience.  Cost Strategy & Profitability:  Develop and own the P&L for assigned zones; implement cost-effective strategies in manpower, infra, and routing.  Partner with finance to ensure accurate reconciliation, cash management, and profitability at the micro-hub level.  Team Management & Grooming:  Hire, train, and groom delivery personnel and on-ground operation leads via structured OJT and performance tracking mechanisms.  Drive a high-performance culture through regular reviews, productivity benchmarks, and upskilling.  Stakeholder Management:  Coordinate closely with client partners to align on daily ops, performance expectations, and escalation handling.  Support inter-city ops alignment, especially in expanding geographies.  Experience: 3–8 years in hyperlocal/Quick-commerce logistics; must have led operations and 3P logistics in a leadership role.  Industry Exposure: Hyperlocal delivery, ecommerce logistics, food/grocery delivery, or quick commerce.  Skill Set:   Strong command over ground operations and supply chain mechanics (Last Mile). Analytical mindset with a focus on cost vs. performance.  Excellent team handling, stakeholder engagement, and communication skills.
