title: Sr Manager, Software Development Engineering
description:
Job Summary At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, youll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. Introduction to team: Data is central to how Expedia Group operates, serves travellers, and makes decisions. When data is incomplete, inaccurate, delayed, or difficult to interpret, the impact can extend across products, analytics, operations, and customer experiences. The Data Quality Platform team is responsible for building a centralized, scalable, and extensible platform that helps teams proactively understand, validate, and trust their data across batch and streaming datasets. We provide automated profiling, configurable quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, alerting, and data health visibility so data producers can identify and resolve issues closer to the source. We focus on building reliable, high-performance, secure, and cost-effective platform services that integrate with data pipelines and analytical systems. Typical technologies include Java, Kotlin, Spring, REST, gRPC, Amazon Web Services, Spark, Kafka, Airflow and Agentic AI. We encourage experimentation with new technologies, including machine-assisted data quality workflows, while balancing short- and long-term goals and maintaining a high bar for platform quality and operational excellence. In this role, you will: Lead, coach, and develop one software engineering team responsible for designing, building, and operating robust, scalable, and secure Data Quality Platform services. Set technical direction for your team across data profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, alerting, incident management, and data health experiences. Lead and collaborate on complex, cross-organizational initiatives, making thoughtful resource, delivery, product, and architectural trade-offs to maximize strategic value. Partner closely with product managers, architects, program managers, data platform teams, and data domain owners to prioritize roadmaps, clarify requirements, and deliver measurable outcomes. Define and raise engineering standards for coding, testing, architecture, observability, security, continuous delivery, performance, and cost management. Ensure reliable operation of production systems through effective on-call strategies, incident management, root-cause analysis, capacity planning, and continuous improvement of service-level indicators and objectives. Safely integrate and operate machine-assisted capabilities that improve rule authoring, anomaly detection, and issue explanation, applying artificial intelligence and machine learning concepts to practical data platform workflows. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor s Degree or Equivalent Level; Technical Degree Preferred. 8+ years of relevant professional experience and 3+ years of people management experience. Proven track record of end-to-end ownership for complex software or data platform systems, including system design, application programming interface design, data modelling, implementation, and ongoing operations within a defined product or domain scope. Strong proficiency in core software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, testing, continuous integration and delivery, and building secure, reliable, and observable services. Experience working with data platforms, data quality, data observability, data pipelines, data contracts, analytics systems, or a closely related domain. Demonstrated ability to set technical direction, make data-driven trade-offs, and align cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-quality software at scale. Preferred Qualifications Experience leading a software engineering team within a large-scale, distributed technology environment, with accountability for team-level architecture, technical strategy, and delivery outcomes. Track record of designing and evolving high-throughput data systems, including service decomposition, data modelling at scale, backward-compatible application programming interfaces, and integration with batch or streaming pipelines. Deep experience with production operations at scale, including site reliability engineering practices, capacity planning, performance optimization, and building systems for high availability and resilience. Demonstrated ability to drive architectural modernization, platform migration, or legacy system deprecation while maintaining strong delivery and operational outcomes. Experience with cloud-native data processing, workflow orchestration, data contracts, anomaly detection, machine-assisted software or data quality workflows, and observability platforms. Proven ability to build an inclusive, high-performance engineering culture and develop engineers through feedback, coaching, career planning, and meaningful technical opportunities. Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Manager – Quality with strong hands-on experience in IPQC / In-Process Quality Control within the automotive two-wheeler or EV industry . The role will be responsible for driving process quality, vehicle assembly quality, defect prevention, process audits, quality systems and continuous improvement across manufacturing operations. Ensure adherence to SOPs, work instructions, control plans, inspection standards and process parameters . Drive containment and corrective actions for repeat defects and line-quality issues . Establish and monitor EOL testing and functional inspection for vehicle assembly. Ensure traceability of critical components and process parameters. Drive SPC, MSA, process capability (Cp/Cpk) and statistical quality improvement initiatives wherever applicable. Support new product development, pilot builds and process validation from a quality perspective. Review and improve PFMEA, Control Plans, Process Flow, Inspection Standards and SOPs . Drive supplier-related quality issues in coordination with SQE/Supplier Quality teams. Lead quality improvement projects, Kaizen and continuous improvement initiatives . Prepare and review daily/weekly/monthly quality MIS and management dashboards. Develop and mentor the IPQC/Quality engineering team . Must-Have Experience 10–15 years of experience in Quality within the automotive / two-wheeler / EV manufacturing industry . Strong and demonstrated experience in IPQC / In-Process Quality Control . Experience in vehicle assembly quality is highly preferred. Strong exposure to process audits, product audits and line quality . Experience with RCA, 8D, CAPA, 5 Why, Fishbone, Pareto and problem-solving methodologies . Good knowledge of PFMEA, Control Plan, SPC, MSA and APQP . Experience in monitoring FTR/FPY, rejection, rework, PPM and customer/field complaints . Exposure to EOL testing / functional testing of vehicles. Experience in a fast-paced OEM/start-up manufacturing environment . Engineering degree in Mechanical / Automobile / Production / Electrical / Electronics . Six Sigma / Quality certification will be an added advantage. Ideal Candidate Profile Two-wheeler OEM + 10–15 years Quality experience + strong IPQC ownership + Vehicle Assembly Quality + Process Audit + RCA/CAPA + PFMEA/Control Plan + EOL + team management.

Identify quantity variations, deviations and additional works and assess their financial impact. Assist in preparation of project budgets, cost estimates and cost forecasts. Monitor project quantities and ensure effective control over material and construction costs. B. Billing & Certification Review and certify contractor/sub-contractor RA bills based on actual site measurements and contractual terms. Ensure proper measurement and documentation of executed quantities. Verify work completion, measurements, supporting documents and applicable deductions before bill certification. Coordinate with Site, Planning, Purchase, Finance and Projects teams for timely processing of bills. Monitor advances, retention money, recoveries, deductions, mobilization advances and other contractual adjustments. Maintain billing records and prepare monthly billing and cost reports. Ensure timely closure of pending bills, final bills and account settlements. C. Contracts Management Review work orders, contracts, BOQs, specifications, terms & conditions and commercial clauses. Monitor contractor compliance with contractual obligations, milestones and payment terms. Handle variation orders, extra items, substituted items and deviations . Evaluate contractors' claims and recommend appropriate commercial settlements. Review and assess EOT, escalation, rate analysis and other contractual claims . Maintain proper records of contract amendments, correspondence, approvals and commercial commitments. Support resolution of contractual disputes and commercial issues with contractors. D. Cost Control & Commercial Management Monitor project expenditure against approved budgets and identify cost overruns. Prepare cost-to-complete and forecast reports for ongoing projects. Analyze project cost trends and highlight potential financial risks to management. Conduct rate analysis for new, extra and substituted items. Support value engineering initiatives to optimize project cost without compromising quality. Maintain project-wise commitment, expenditure and balance cost statements. E. Coordination & MIS Coordinate with Project, Engineering, Planning, Procurement, Finance and Accounts teams. Provide regular commercial and billing MIS to senior management. Prepare reports on project billing, contractor payments, variations, commitments and cost status. Ensure proper documentation and audit readiness of all commercial records. Participate in contractor meetings and resolve billing/commercial issues. 3. REQUIRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIES Strong knowledge of Quantity Surveying, BOQ, Rate Analysis and Measurement . Good understanding of construction contracts and commercial terms . Strong experience in contractor billing and certification. Ability to read and interpret civil/architectural drawings. Strong negotiation, coordination and communication skills. Ability to independently manage commercial activities for multiple projects. Preferred: Additional qualification/certification in Quantity Surveying, Contracts Management, Construction Management or Commercial Management. 6. Team Leadership Lead, coach, and develop regional administration teams through effective performance management, capability building, and succession planning. Experience in aviation, airports, hospitality, logistics, infrastructure, manufacturing, retail, or other operationally intensive environments will be preferred. Experience in airport administration, aviation operations, or management of facilities within operationally critical and high-security environments will be preferred. Strong understanding of facility operations, compliance requirements, and business continuity practices. Proven experience managing relationships with airport operators, regulatory authorities, government agencies, service providers, and key business stakeholders. Strong commercial acumen with experience in vendor management, contract administration, budgeting, and cost optimization. Demonstrated experience in crisis management, incident response, and business continuity support. Strong knowledge of the regional operating environment, stakeholder ecosystem, and local business landscape. Preference will be given to candidates with experience operating in the East Region. Knowledge of Bengali and/or other regional languages will be an advantage. title: International Customer Support Specialist
description:
International Customer Support Specialist
 Chennai, India 
 At Vendasta, we re leading the AI revolution from Saskatoon to Chennai-and beyond. We work together to empower our partners and customers through our AI-powered customer acquisition and engagement platform to help them get more customers and keep them. We re proud to share that Vendasta has officially been named one of Canada s Most Admired Corporate Cultures! 
 We re looking for an International Customer Support Specialist who is energized by delivering outstanding omnichannel customer service and technical support with speed, accuracy, and delight. In this role, you will act as a trusted expert of Vendasta s platform, fostering a customer-first environment, adopting advanced AI support tools, and ensuring that every single customer interaction adds value and strengthens trust. 
 Your Impact As an International Customer Support Specialist, youll work with customer support teams, product managers, and customers to: Deliver Omnichannel Support: Serve as the primary touchpoint for customer inquiries, providing timely, empathetic, and accurate resolution across phone, email, chat, and video calls. Drive Efficiency via AI Fluency: Consistently integrate approved AI tools (e.g., suggestion bots, summarizers, and response tools) into your daily workflows to reduce resolution times, maximize accuracy, and maintain a one-touch solve rate of 68% or higher . Own Knowledge Process Updates: Maintain, update, and verify internal and customer-facing documentation-including validating AI-generated draft updates-to ensure resource accuracy reflects the latest platform changes. Advocate for the Customer: Gather real-time customer feedback, input trends into internal AI systems, conduct product walkthroughs, and participate in sprint reviews to proactively champion the customer experience and support platform evolution. Deliver Strategic Metrics: Track and improve Key Performance Indicators-such as Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), first response time, AI tool usage compliance, and the accuracy of AI tagging-to meet organizational performance benchmarks.

 What You Bring to the Table You bring 1-2 years of experience in customer service, support, or a related field, ideally within a SaaS or fast-paced technology environment. You possess dtrong Technical Ability. You possess strong written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to translate complex technical platform issues into warm, clear, and actionable solutions for customers. You have a basic understanding of AI-driven workflows and feel confident navigating AI-powered assistance tools (prior exposure to automation tools or AI chat interfaces is a strong asset). You are highly proficient with customer support platforms (such as Zendesk or Intercom) and have an analytical aptitude for triaging tickets based on severity and time sensitivity. You have a proven track record of multitasking and prioritizing in a dynamic, high-volume environment while maintaining a solution-oriented mindset. You have a strong technical aptitude for identifying software bugs, gathering context, conducting troubleshooting screen-shares, and escalating issues appropriately. 
 About Vendasta We help businesses get more customers. And keep them. Vendasta is an AI-powered customer acquisition and engagement platform for SMBs and the partners who support them, streamlining marketing, sales, and operations through intelligent AI employees, automation, and real-time actions and insights. From creating awareness to nurturing lasting customer relationships, Vendasta offers a suite of solutions with AI assistants that streamline every stage of the customer journey. By combining a businesss unique data with AI and automation, Vendasta simplifies marketing, sales, and operations, eliminating the need for multiple disjointed systems. 
 Perks At Vendasta, you ll work alongside driven, curious teammates in a culture rooted in Drive, Innovation, Respect, and Agility, solving meaningful problems that shape the future of local business. We invest deeply in your development through continuous learning opportunities, hands-on exposure to emerging technologies, in-house training, education reimbursement, and leadership development programs designed to help you grow as the world evolves. We support this growth with flexibility, wellness benefits, and an environment that trusts you to do your best work - whether that s learning something new, taking on bigger challenges, or building the next chapter of your career. At Vendasta, you re not just keeping up with change. You re growing with it. Health insurance benefits Paid Time Off (PTO) Night Shift Premium Provident Fund Cab Facilities Free snacks, hot beverages, and catered lunches on Fridays

 Discover your potential. Build something that matters. Join the AI revolution from right here in Chennai.

title: Sales Officer LAP
description:
Group Company: AU Small Finance Bank Limited Designation: Sales Officer MBL 
 
 Job Summary 
 Position description: Generate fresh Business and service existing clients 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Achieve assigned targets for sales regular collection Conduct Marketing activities, leafleting , Canopy etc to identify new sources of business Handle customer queries, build up customer relationship and develop brand value in the market Attend customer queries and provide resolution Co-ordinate with Operations Collection department for customer onboarding and servicing Conduct physical verification of customer's residence, business and any other asset crucial from credit point of view and taking photographs. Follow instructions frm seniors, coordinate with internal teams for getting visit reports done. Visit customers for first FI and meeting, and also accompany seniors to customer's place for visit and verification. Conduct physical verification of credit related documents like ITR, Bank statement, receipts, ledger and property documents - doing OSV ( Original Seen and verified) of documents. Prepare basic CAM ( Credit Appraisal Memo) Take reference check of customers from local market and existing customers. Follow policies procedure as laid down by the bank. Portfolio Management - visit delinquent cases, collect EMIs of delinquent cases in collaboration with collections team. Maintain and stop early delinquency , Non-starter cases in portfolio, decide the treatment of such cases wisely. Maintain least OTC / PDD pendency and ensure timely clearance of the same. Maintain non-RPDC portfolio - ensure all cases of portfolio are ACH. Maintain and collect fresh bouncing cases EMI with charges as mentioned in policy, Correct the operational errors and get 100% cases repayment in Non-PDC mode. Collect fresh data from open marketing activities for tele calling and self sourcing. Follow leads so generated from data received from telemarketing team Complete documentation, file agreements, formats and other formalities for disbursement of cases Clear queries from credit, Ops, Legal, Valuation etc. Timely submit daily MIS and sourcing data to reporting authority 
 
 Additional Responsibilities 
 Provide true and fair opinion based on customer's interaction. Clear queries of customers - clarify final ROI, Fees, Charges, and all other terms of the case Do not get involved in any financial/non-financial transaction with the customer Maintain decency and good behaviour while dealing with the customer, visiting property, especially while taking photos of the house and surroundings with permission of the customer. Conduct customer reference checks with utmost sincerity and maturity - goodwill of the client should not be hampered - not disclose any financial or personal information of existing / new clients with any ( existing / prospective clients ) or any 3rd party

title: Full Time Permanent Work From Home - Customer Support and Sales
description:
Permanent Work From Home | Domestic Process | Healthcare Diagnostics 
 We are an authorised all-India sales partner for Thyrocare, India's largest diagnostic lab. This is a permanent work-from-home role no office visits, no relocation, open to candidates in any city in India. 
 Please read the schedule carefully before applying. 
 This role is 6 days a week, 10 hours a day, on rotational shifts. If that doesn't suit you, this is not the right role and we'd rather you know now. 
 Shift timings (rotational, assigned as per business requirement): 7:00 AM 5:00 PM 9:00 AM 7:00 PM 12:00 PM 10:00 PM One weekly off, on a rotational day, communicated in advance. Weekends are working days. 
 Role & responsibilities Handle customer queries on call and WhatsApp and convert them into confirmed bookings this is a sales-led support role, not a query-closing desk. Understand each customer's requirements in detail and recommend the right health checkup package as per the pre-defined SOPs only. Own every customer end to end — from first enquiry to order booking to sample collection to final report delivery. No handoffs, no dropped threads. Follow the process exactly as documented. Ask when information is missing rather than assuming. Maintain accurate order and customer records. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 Minimum 1 year of voice-based customer support or tele sales experience. Freshers please do not apply. Fluent verbal and written communication in English and Hindi . Ability to understand what a customer actually needs, not just what they ask for. Comfortable with Excel, Word, WhatsApp and email. Good negotiation skills. Own laptop in excellent working condition, wired broadband connection, and power backup covering laptop and router for the full shift. A dedicated workspace at home with zero background noise and zero interruptions. Candidates with a career gap, and women returning to work after a break, are welcome to apply. 
 Salary & benefits Fixed: 18,000 – 23,000 per month in hand , based on English fluency and relevant experience. Monthly performance incentive: up to 10,000 . Loyalty bonus: 6,000 on completion of every 6 months. Realistic earning potential: 25,000 – 30,000 per month. Salary credited to your bank account every month. Detailed hands-on training provided. This is a permanent role and we are looking for people who want to stay and grow with us. 
 How to apply 
 Apply through Naukri, or email your CV to thyrocare@live.com or thyromail@gmail.com . 
 In your email or Naukri message, mention: (1) your Laptop RAM, (2) your power backup arrangement. Applications without these details will not be shortlisted.

title: Customer support travel specialist
description:
Customer support travel specialist 
Our philosophy for customer service is simple: Listen to the customer. Understand their needs. Take ownership. Solve the problem. When a customer contacts Miraee, you take the responsibility till the need is addressed or the issue is solved. You will own urgent disruptions, complex multi-leg trips, VIP requests, and edge cases the AI agents couldn't resolve. Our customers include CEOs, CFOs, senior executives, executive assistants, and frequent business travelers with urgent and complex travel needs. 
 You will own four KPIs: First-Response Time (FRT) Resolution Time Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) Ownership Rate End-to-End Issue Resolution 
 What you will do Handle flight changes, cancellations, rebooking, delays, missed connections, and other travel disruptions especially last-minute and complex requests. Book domestic and international flights, hotels, car rentals, rail, airport transfers, and ground transportation when the frequent travelers are in need. Flag recurring pain points and agent failure patterns to Product and Engineering so the AI improves - you are a key input to our product feedback loop. Support travelers with check-in, seat and upgrade requests, and hotel needs such as early check-in and late checkout. Assist with restaurant bookings, private dinners, meetings, conferences, and other business travel needs. Understand the traveler's schedule and recommend the best available option. Work directly with airlines, hotels, and travel partners to resolve customer issues. Support customers across phone, chat, email, and messaging; keep them updated until the issue is fully resolved. Escalate account-level or program-level issues to the Enterprise Customer Success Manager; you own the traveler, they own the account. 
 Experience needed 3 - 5 years in corporate travel, business travel, airline ticketing, travel agency, or travel customer support. Hands-on experience with at least one GDS: Sabre, Amadeus, Apollo, Galileo, or Travelport. Experience handling US domestic and international travel. Experience supporting business travelers, senior executives, VIPs, or frequent travelers. Strong understanding of flight bookings, changes, cancellations, exchanges, refunds, and fare rules. Experience handling travel disruptions and last-minute changes. Prior experience at a corporate travel desk or travel management company preferred. 
 Skills we value Excellent spoken and written English. Strong attention to detail. Sound problem-solving and decision-making. Comfortable with demanding travelers with complex needs. Able to manage multiple customer requests simultaneously. Takes ownership instead of passing problems along. Comfortable with travel technology and quick to learn new systems including working alongside AI agents.

JOB DESCRIPTION 
 DIGITAL MARKETING EXECUTIVE PERFORMANCE MARKETING & SEO 
 Company: Fintellect Associates
 Location: Bangalore
 Employment Type: Full-Time

 Department: Digital Marketing & Lead Generation
 About Fintellect Associates 
Fintellect Associates is a growing professional training and career services organization specializing in Practical Accounting & Taxation Training, Accounting Services, Placement Services and employability-focused programs.
We are looking for a Digital Marketing Executive to take complete ownership of our digital marketing activities and lead-generation campaigns.
 Role Overview 
Our social media platforms, basic optimization, advertising setup and lead funnel have already been established with the support of a digital marketing agency. The selected candidate will take over the existing setup and be responsible for SEO, Google Ads, paid campaigns, lead generation, campaign optimization and digital performance tracking.
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Google Ads & Paid Campaigns 
 Plan, create and manage Google Search, Display and other relevant Google Ads campaigns. Conduct keyword research and identify high-intent keywords. Create and optimize campaigns for course admissions and business lead generation. Manage campaign budgets and improve CPL, conversion rate and ROI. Monitor search terms, negative keywords, CTR, CPC and conversions. Continuously A/B test ad copies, keywords, landing pages and campaigns. Identify opportunities to scale successful campaigns. 2. SEO 
 Develop and execute an SEO strategy for the company's website and landing pages. Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis. Implement on-page SEO, including titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal linking and content optimization. Work on technical SEO and identify website issues affecting rankings. Develop and execute off-page SEO and quality backlink strategies. Improve organic traffic, keyword rankings and lead generation. Coordinate with content writers/web developers wherever required. 3. Lead Generation & Funnel Management 
 Manage and optimize existing lead-generation funnels. Monitor leads generated through Google Ads, social media and website. Track lead quality and conversion performance. Work closely with the admission/sales team to improve lead-to-admission conversion. Identify drop-offs in the funnel and recommend improvements. Create campaign-wise performance reports. 4. Social Media Management 
 Take ownership of the existing social media setup. Coordinate with graphic designers/content creators for regular posts, reels and promotional creatives. Plan content calendars based on business objectives. Monitor engagement and identify opportunities for organic growth. Support paid social media campaigns when required. 5. Analytics & Reporting 
 Set up and manage Google Analytics and Google Search Console. Monitor website traffic, user behaviour and conversions. Track campaign performance using appropriate analytics and reporting tools. Prepare weekly/monthly digital marketing performance reports. Provide actionable recommendations based on campaign data. Required Skills 
 Google Ads Google Analytics / GA4 Google Search Console SEO & Keyword Research Google Tag Manager Landing Page & Conversion Optimization Lead Generation Meta Ads / Facebook & Instagram Ads Basic knowledge of WordPress/CMS Google Sheets/Excel Competitor Research & Digital Marketing Analytics Preferred Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business, Commerce or a related field. 13 years of hands-on digital marketing experience. Candidates with experience in education, training, coaching, recruitment or lead-generation businesses will be preferred. What We Are Looking For 
We are looking for someone who is hands-on and performance-oriented, not someone who only coordinates with agencies. The candidate should be able to:
 Take ownership of digital marketing activities. Independently manage Google Ads campaigns. Build and execute an SEO strategy. Generate quality leads within the allocated budget. Analyse campaign data and make decisions based on performance. Continuously test and improve campaigns. Work closely with the sales/admission team to improve conversions. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 Qualified leads generated Cost per lead (CPL) Google Ads conversion rate Lead-to-admission conversion Advertising ROI/ROAS Website organic traffic SEO keyword rankings Organic leads generated Landing-page conversion rate Overall digital marketing performance

title: Head Digital Marketing
description:
Role & responsibilities The Head of Digital Marketing owns the growth and profitability of Ahujasons digital business. That means the e-commerce store, the corporate gifting demand engine, and the brand presence that feeds both. The person is accountable for revenue and return on ad spend, and equally for building a team and a system that keeps producing results without depending on any one individual. This is not a hands-off strategy role. The person will still get into ad accounts, still read the numbers themselves, and still write creative briefs. The difference from the current setup is leadership: the ability to direct a content team toward creative that actually converts, to develop people, and to run the function with discipline through a highly seasonal business cycle. Annual media budget under management 
 Approximately Rs. 65 lakh to Rs. 90 lakh. Current run rate is Rs. 15,000 to Rs. 20,000 per day on e-commerce and Rs. 3,000 to Rs. 5,000 per day on corporate gifting, with seasonal swings. Budget is not the constraint; return on it is. Revenue lines owned 
 E-commerce (own Shopify store, no marketplaces) and corporate gifting lead generation. Combined digital-led revenue to be confirmed by Finance before the role is offered. Channels 
 Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO, email marketing, WhatsApp marketing, LinkedIn and Lusha outbound, organic social. Direct reports 
 Social Media Manager. Content team of photographer, video editor and graphic designer. Functional coordination with the web developer and the e-commerce operations team. Indirect scope 
 Shopify storefront experience, product listing quality, order status visibility, inbound enquiry handling. Reports to 
 Director, Digital Divisions. 
 Preferred candidate profile Essential 8 to 12 years in digital marketing, with at least 3 years leading a team of five or more. Direct, hands-on ownership of Meta Ads and Google Ads accounts at a monthly spend of Rs. 5 lakh or above. Agency oversight alone is not sufficient; we need someone who has been accountable for the number, not for the client relationship. Proven experience running a Shopify or comparable D2C store as a revenue line, including conversion rate work, not only traffic acquisition. Demonstrated ability to brief and direct creative teams. The candidate should be able to explain, with examples, how they turned a creative idea into a measurable performance result. B2B or corporate lead generation experience, ideally including LinkedIn and outbound tooling. Practical AI fluency: routine use of AI tools for creative production, copy, campaign analysis, reporting and automation, with specific examples of workflows they have built and what those workflows saved or earned. Comfort with a seasonal, inventory-led business where demand concentrates into a few months. Preferred Background in fashion, apparel, accessories, gifting, jewellery or a comparable visual-led category. Exposure to a family-run or promoter-led business, where influence matters more than formal authority. Experience with email and WhatsApp retention marketing, not just acquisition. SEO depth, including technical SEO on Shopify. Remuneration shall not be a limiting factor for the right candidate

title: Structural Design Engineer
description:
Structural Engineer Mumbai Location: Mumbai, India
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Experience: 6 - 9 Years
 Department: Structural Design Engineering
 Industry: Engineering Consultancy / Building Services Joining: Immediate joiners preferred 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a skilled and motivated Structural Engineer to join our engineering team in Mumbai. The successful candidate will be responsible for structural analysis, design, and preparation of engineering deliverables for a range of building and infrastructure projects. 
 The role requires strong technical knowledge, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate effectively with architects, MEP engineers, and other project stakeholders. 
 Key Responsibilities Perform structural analysis and design of RCC, steel, and other structural systems . Prepare structural calculations, design reports, drawings, and technical specifications. Develop and review structural framing schemes and structural details. Carry out analysis using relevant structural engineering software. Coordinate structural designs with architectural, MEP, and other disciplines. Review structural drawings and ensure compliance with project requirements and applicable codes and standards. Assist in preparing design concepts, calculations, specifications, and technical submissions. Review contractor/shop drawings and respond to technical queries and RFIs. Participate in design coordination meetings and provide technical input as required. Identify and resolve structural design and coordination issues. Ensure all deliverables are completed within agreed project timelines and quality standards. Support senior engineers and project managers in delivering projects successfully. 
 Required Qualifications & Experience: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering / Structural Engineering . Master's degree in Structural Engineering will be an advantage. 6-9 years of relevant experience in structural design and consultancy. Strong knowledge of RCC and steel design . Good understanding of structural analysis principles and design methodologies. Familiarity with relevant Indian Standards (IS Codes) and international codes where applicable. Experience with structural analysis/design software such as ETABS, SAFE, STAAD.Pro, SAP2000 , or equivalent. Good working knowledge of AutoCAD ; Revit Structure/BIM experience is an advantage. Ability to read and interpret architectural and structural drawings. Strong coordination and communication skills. Ability to work independently as well as part of a multidisciplinary team. 
 Preferred Skills Experience working on residential, commercial, hospitality, high-rise, or mixed-use projects . Experience in a multidisciplinary engineering consultancy environment. Knowledge of BIM and coordinated design workflows. Experience in reviewing drawings and technical submissions. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Good written and verbal communication skills. 
 What We Offer Opportunity to work on a variety of challenging and technically diverse projects. Exposure to multidisciplinary engineering and international project standards. Professional development and opportunities for career growth. Collaborative and technically driven work environment.

Cybersecurity & Information Security Own and strengthen the organization's cybersecurity and infrastructure security posture . Manage/oversee security technologies such as firewalls, EDR/XDR, SIEM/SOC, DLP, MFA, PAM and vulnerability management . Drive patch management, vulnerability assessments and VAPT activities. Ensure compliance with GAMP 5, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles . Support Computer System Validation (CSV) and infrastructure qualification activities. Have practical exposure to GAMP 5 Category 1–5 classification, CSV lifecycle, IQ/OQ/PQ and traceability matrices . Ensure appropriate controls for user access, privileged access, audit trails, backup, restoration, data retention and electronic records. Ensure IT policies, SOPs, validation documents and supporting records are audit-ready. Drive timely remediation and closure of IT-related audit observations and CAPAs. IAM, Backup & Disaster Recovery Manage enterprise-wide Identity & Access Management (IAM) and Joiner-Mover-Leaver processes. Ensure periodic access reviews for critical and GxP systems. Manage enterprise authentication, directory services and access controls. Establish and maintain backup, Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity processes. Define and monitor RTO/RPO for critical systems and conduct periodic DR drills and backup restoration testing. Vendor, Budget & Asset Management Manage IT infrastructure and cybersecurity vendors, service providers and AMC partners. Participate in technical/commercial evaluation and vendor negotiations. Maintain IT asset inventory, CMDB, software licenses, warranties and lifecycle plans. Manage IT Infrastructure and Information Security CAPEX/OPEX budgets and identify cost optimization opportunities. Team Leadership Lead and develop the IT Infrastructure & Security team . Set objectives, review performance, coach team members and build technical/security capabilities. Ensure effective knowledge transfer, succession planning and documentation of critical infrastructure. Prepare management dashboards covering infrastructure availability, cybersecurity, vulnerabilities, incidents, SLA performance, DR/backup, audit/CAPA status and IT expenditure.
